result.summary: Found 4 issues: layout cutoff on the right edge, an inconsistent bottom navigation state, a truncated restaurant name, and minor spacing inconsistency in category filters.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section's third card (Trattoria Piccolo) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, indicating horizontal scroll content is not properly contained or indicated.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual cue (partial card fade or scroll indicator) to show the row is scrollable, or adjust padding so cards are not abruptly clipped by the screen edge.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis, making it look like a text/content error.
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis truncation or ensure text wraps/scales appropriately so names are not abruptly cut off.

issues.description: The 'Profile' bottom navigation icon is highlighted in green while the current screen content shown resembles the Home feed, creating a mismatch between highlighted nav state and displayed content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the active navigation tab accurately reflects the currently displayed screen/content.

issues.description: The category filter row (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is also clipped at the right edge, cutting off what appears to be an additional category option.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/scroll affordance or ensure enough right padding so the last item isn't partially hidden.
